verdicts.matching_evidence: In the caption of Figure 1, the 2D contour levels are defined as: "$1\sigma$ (39.3%), $1.5\sigma$ (67.5%), $2\sigma$ (56.5%) and $3\sigma$ (98.9%)". The $2\sigma$ value is mathematically incorrect. For a 2D Gaussian (Rayleigh distribution of the radius), the cumulative probability enclosed is $1 - \exp(-r^2/2)$. For $r=2$, this yields $1 - \exp(-2) \approx 86.47\%$. The "56.5%" value is a typographical error. Recommendation: Correct "56.5%" to "86.5%" in the Figure 1 caption.
